ME: One scorched taco, 800 degrees Fahrenheit, extra fast!
VE: Sulfuric acid drizzle on my carbon dioxide burger!
EA: I'll take clean liquid water and plant salad.
JU: Super-size it! I eat ninety-five moons of snacks!
SA: Does the ice ring combo come with helium?
TI: I prefer a tall glass of liquid methane!
PL: A tiny frozen nitrogen nugget is plenty, thanks.

SU: You cannot hide, I light up the system!
ME: I hide right behind the Sun at dawn!
VE: Thick clouds hide my surface from every camera!
NE: I hid so far it took math to find!
CE: I blend in with thousands of asteroid buddies!
ER: Good luck spotting me in the scattered disc!

SU: Four point six billion candles? That melts everything!
ME: My year is eighty-eight days, party every three months!
EA: Three hundred sixty-five days until my next birthday!
JU: One orbit takes twelve Earth years, save cake!
SA: Twenty-nine Earth years between birthdays? I feel old!
NE: One party every one hundred sixty-five Earth years!
PL: Two hundred forty-eight years per birthday is absurd!
ER: Five hundred fifty-eight years? Still waiting for cake!

VE: Nine hundred degrees with heavy sulfuric acid overcast!
MA: Global dust storms block out the entire Sun!
JU: The Great Red Spot is four hundred years old!
SA: Winds hit one thousand miles per hour today!
TI: Liquid methane drizzle over northern polar lakes today!

EA: Officer, thirty kilometers a second is Earth standard!
JU: Thirteen kilometers a second, but I am heavy!
SA: Nine kilometers per second, just cruising my rings!
NE: Five kilometers a second, strictly outer solar zone!
PL: Four kilometers per second, going at dwarf pace!

ME: Solar wind blasted all my car paint off!
VE: Acid rain melted the sponges, scrub harder please!
MA: Red iron dust gets into all my gears!
JU: No wash! My ammonia gas stripes look marvelous!
UR: Rinse me sideways, my ninety-eight degree tilt helps!
EN: I spray water geysers to wash everyone else!

ME: Zero moons, zero atmosphere, entry denied everywhere!
EA: One moon stamp and eight billion living visas!
MA: Two tiny captured asteroid moons on my visa!
JU: Ninety-five moon visas, my passport booklet is huge!
SA: One hundred forty-six moon stamps and counting, winner!
PL: Dwarf planet passport since two thousand six, rude!
GA: Bigger than Mercury, yet stamped as a moon!

SU: My magnetic field flips polarity every eleven years!
ME: Only one percent of Earth, barely deflects wind!
EA: Liquid iron core shields surface life from radiation!
GA: I am the only moon with magnetic shielding!
MA: No core dynamo, just tiny crustal magnetic patches!

ME: Movie is two hours, my daylight lasts months!
VE: I cannot see the screen through dense clouds!
EA: Twenty-four hour day, perfect for a movie night!
SA: Popcorn ice rings make the best movie snack!
NE: It took four hours for light to arrive!

VE: Bake it at 900 degrees Fahrenheit, perfectly melted!
JU: My Great Red Spot looks like giant pepperoni!
EA: I brought fresh mushrooms, tomatoes, and liquid water!
SA: Careful, my ice rings might slice thin crust!
PL: Keep mine frozen at minus 380 degrees Fahrenheit!
EN: Liquid ocean under ice, talk about deep dish!
